correction_scope: The only implementation correction is to read canonical source JSONL with the established ASCII-escaped source serializer instead of the saved-artifact UTF-8 serializer. No data, scientific method, seed, threshold, band, calibration, fit, stopping, probe, monitor, hypothesis or interpretation changes are authorized.
execution_policy: Authorize one new complete six-stage sequence in a fresh root reservation after the parser-only correction. The exhausted v1 attempt is not retried, resumed or promoted, and there is no automatic retry.
inheritance: Inherit unchanged from the v1 profile and methods contract all data, stages, seeds, models, artifacts, thresholds, bands, calibration, fit and stop rules, probes, monitors, hypotheses and interpretation.
saved_evidence_canonicalization: Saved evidence retains the existing UTF-8 artifact canonicalizer; only canonical source JSONL uses the established ASCII-escaped source serializer.
one_use_enforcement: One-use is a prospective policy enforced by an operator-controlled launch, a fresh root reservation with create-only paths, and fail-stop handling; it is not a global execution ledger across arbitrary filesystem paths.
